name: Bubble Wand
summary: Hold to blow a rainbow soap bubble from a wand, let it float off, and race a cat to pop them
about: A pastel park with a picket fence, a curious cat and a hand holding a bubble wand. Hold down and a shimmering bubble swells out of the ring with a size label, let go and it pinches off and drifts on the breeze with a wobbling rainbow film; hold too long and it bursts, while a quick tap blows a puff of little ones. Good for a kids or party page, a soap or bath shop, or a playful loading screen.
how: Press and hold the scene, the Hold to blow button or Space; let go to set the bubble free before it bursts.
Tap quickly (or press Quick puff) for a cloud of small bubbles; tap any bubble to pop it into droplets.
The cat on the fence watches the nearest bubble and swipes at any that float within reach.
Move your pointer to steer the wand a little and stir up a breeze; the score keeps your record size.
With reduced motion the bubbles drift slower and barely wobble, and pops make fewer droplets.
